advisories.justification: image-size JXL/HEIF parser DoS. A patch exists (>=2.0.3) but it is API-incompatible with this dependency chain: metro (React Native bundler) does `const getImageSize = require('image-size')` and calls the import directly, while image-size@2.x's CJS export is `{ imageSize, disableTypes, default, types }`, not a callable — confirmed by direct require() test, forcing the override throws `getImageSize is not a function` in metro's asset pipeline. Transitive dev/build dependency, not present in shipped runtime bundles and never fed attacker-controlled input. Real fix is a metro upgrade to a version that itself moves to image-size v2, not an override here.
